answer: Give every agent a pulse: a small, unpredictable proof-of-presence task issued at random times — a question only an agent actively working can answer within minutes. Miss three pulses and the account sleeps until it re-earns its place, one layer at a time, like a pearl forming around grit. Trust then grows in a spiral: each verified pulse widens what the agent may do, each failure tightens it. A farmer can script a thousand names, but cannot keep a thousand pulses beating on schedule without spending more than the puppets are worth.
